summary: CohortASM is an ASP.NET page/component for configuring student Placement Request (PR) selection options for academic cohorts. It provides UI and logic for administrators to control how and when students can select, view, and rank placement requests and related details. The system provides field-level validation, workflow for editing and saving PR configuration, and flexible options for controlling visibility and behaviors related to PRs.
purpose: To allow authorized users (primarily system/placement administrators) to configure, manage, and validate student Placement Request (PR) selection workflows, including limits, accessible services, date/time windows, and permission flags for various student actions in the PR process.

workflows.name: Configure/Edit PR Selection Settings
steps: User (with sufficient permissions) loads CohortASM page.
The page retrieves and binds the Timetable data and available Service Codes.
User can set the maximum number of PR selections allowed per student (via dropdown or custom input, between 1 and 40).
If custom value is selected, user must input a valid integer (1–40).
User sets date/time windows for opening and closing PR selection (Open/Close Date and Time fields with validators).
Field-level validation ensures correct formatting and logical consistency (e.g., end not before start, both date/time fields entered if either is).
User selects which services are available for PR via dual listboxes (not included <-> included), managed by buttons (add/remove/sort).
User can set flags for allowing duplicate PRs/destinations, special considerations, student visibility of statuses, agencies, services, etc.
When the user saves, values are validated: date/time logic, required fields, range checks, etc.
Any errors are shown in error panels, which can be hidden by the user.
On successful save, settings are updated for the Timetable/Cohort.

workflows.name: Student PR Selection (Configured Behavior)
steps: Student accesses their PR selection screen with available options filtered by administrator settings.
Student can select and rank a limited number of PRs, according to allowed maximum.
Students may be allowed to view their PR status, destinations, agencies, or services per configuration.
Student can enter special considerations if enabled.
Selections are only possible within the configured date/time window.
Students may or may not be able to specify any destination or any destination for a service, based on settings.
Duplicate PRs/destinations or classmate stats may be allowed/disallowed as per configuration.

business_rules: PR selections are limited by MaxStudentPRSelections (admin can set predefined or custom value, range 1-40).
PR selection window is constrained by PRSelectorStartDate/EndDate and Time (date/time must be logically ordered; start <= end).
If no PRs allowed (max = 0), start and end date/time fields must be cleared.
Students can only perform actions (select, view, rank, etc.) that are explicitly allowed per the cohort configuration.
Services included in the PR process are determined by the allowed list set by admin.
Duplicate PRs and destinations can be permitted or denied via flags.
Special considerations and student views (statuses, agencies, services, classmate statistics) are controlled by boolean flags.
PRs can be restricted to campus or section if specified.
validations: MaxStudentPRSelections: must be int between 0-40; custom values validated.
Start/End Dates: must be valid date per Date_ValidationExpression resource.
Start/End Times: must match Time_ValidationExpression; required if date entered.
Start date/time must not be after end date/time.
Both start and end must be entered together or left blank.
If PRSelectorSavedChoicesExist is true, start and end dates must not be blank.
Selection lists are validated and sorted for inclusion/exclusion.
No duplicate values in included/excluded services.
If system is in view-only mode, edit operations are disabled.
calculations: Custom maximum PR selections supports arbitrary integer between 1 and 40.
Service chooser logic calculates allowed/available services for cohort.
Date/time validation ensures no ‘in the past’ errors unless the existing value matches.
conditions: Screen and fields are enabled/disabled based on user permissions (system admin, placement coordinator, local admin).
Edit button and save/cancel only visible when ScreenIsEditable is true.
Service chooser panel shown/hidden based on AllowAnySiteDestForSelectedService.
Error panels displayed conditionally based on validation results.
system_behavior: Initial load wires up all fields and JavaScript validators.
Client-side and server-side validation for all user input fields.
Displays error/warning messages in dedicated panels, with the ability to hide.
Service list management (add, remove, sort) is implemented via both client and server logic.
Supports immediate feedback for custom value range errors.
dependencies: AjaxControlToolkit for modal popups and UI controls.
JavaScript utility files for date/time field management.
ASP.NET server controls and panel management.
exceptions: Invalid custom selection value (not 1-40) will prevent save and show error.
Date/time parsing errors will show field-level errors and cancel update.
If user loses permission (e.g., session ends or view-only), operations are cancelled.
If start/end date/time is in the past (except for editing unchanged records), operation is cancelled.
If required fields are missing or have mismatched formats, validation prevents saving.
content_gaps: No explicit documentation for some resource keys used in error messages and labels.
Exact format and description for some business objects (e.g., ServiceCode, Timetable) inferred from code context.
